how_to_use: Parts A–C are facts and constraints. Parts D–E are Opus opinion. Part F lists decisions. Answer SITE00_TREE_REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md; for each family/page/classification use AGREE_WITH_OPUS / PARTIALLY_AGREE / DISAGREE / ALTERNATIVE_RECOMMENDATION.

product_intent.purpose: A commercial digital location that turns graphics into pages, products and worlds; host for its own production and for client projects (SITE 00, JURNL, AIO, FRONTAL SLAYER, future).
Identity product. Diagnoses where a brand is (00–03) and captures an identity intake; first step for most clients.
Build product. Classifies what is being built (SITE / WORLD / SYSTEMS / EXTENSIONS) and captures a build intake.
Evolution product for existing properties (REFINE / INSTALL / TRANSFORM), plus ongoing marketing & content.
Internal production machinery (agents, pipelines, benches, experiments). Never client-facing.
Digital office / spatial world / resident system. Production infrastructure, not a client brand. No surface exists yet.
The client's project room for one project: what needs them, where things are, review/approve, talk, files.
The founder's per-project production environment across seven lenses (HUB … ACTIVITY).
Registry + membership + review/approval + events that let one project be seen by founder and client from one shared truth, isolated from other projects.

PART_B_CURRENT_PROBLEMS.fact: Four parallel client-facing project surfaces exist (/app, /client/projects, /studio/:slug, /projects/:slug) plus CTRL ROOM; none links to the others consistently; CTRL ROOM links to none.
The review loop is broken at send (no publish action), auth (client fetch lacks token → 401), and return (workspace never reads client decisions; gates never unlock).
Production HUB/INBOX/LIBRARY/ACTIVITY are not project-scoped (resolve to ndxbook); SITE 00 is excluded from the project switcher; requests/activity live in localStorage.
53 bench/experiment/debug routes live inside the product namespace (vs 10 production route registrations); 17 have no guard.

Public site: two directories (/enter, /origin/locations) with different items; 9 draft-gated pages redirect to / without ?preview=1; footer legal links point to non-existent routes; BOOK DISCOVERY / CONSULT / NEED GUIDANCE CTAs dead-end; 8 /desktop aliases render blank. The auth footer PRIVACY link also points at /brand/terms (Site00AuthShell.tsx:96).

BLDR classes in the public flow are SITE / WORLD / ENTERPRISE / NOT SURE (bldr-classification.ts:32-34) and the admin intake page uses a third set SITE / WORLD / BRAND / SYSTEM (BldrIntakesPage.tsx:10), vs locked SITE / WORLD / SYSTEMS / EXTENSIONS.
Client app nav is HOME / PROJECTS / REVIEWS / INBOX / PROFILE (a test locks it) vs locked HOME / PROJECT / REVIEWS / INBOX / LIBRARY; LIBRARY has no nav entry.

No invite flow, no project membership, admin = email allowlist (defaults include frontalslayer.com addresses), ~20 unauthenticated API endpoints, 2 tables writable with the anon key, client-chosen review role (project access is still checked first, so the risk is privilege escalation inside a project the client can already open).

≥7 hard-coded project registries + site00_projects with 4 type vocabularies; slug drift (aio vs all-in-one-enterprises, site00 vs site-00); none of FOUNDER/PERSONAL/CLIENT/INTERNAL_SITE00 types exist.
Founder screen authorities are mostly not in the repo (proof halves, code manifests, remote URLs); public/client app/auth/account surfaces have no image authority.
CI on main: 73 of the last 100 runs failed; last green 2026-09-28; build/deploy jobs skipped while tests fail.

PART_C_LOCKED_CONSTRAINTS.decision: DIGITAL LOCATION language (not agency language); do not casually rename locked systems

Product ontology: IDNTY (00 STARTING AT ZERO · 01 SOME PIECES EXIST/PARTIAL · 02 READY FOR EVOLUTION · 03 BUILD READY); BLDR (SITE · WORLD · SYSTEMS · EXTENSIONS); EVOLVE (REFINE · INSTALL · TRANSFORM); STUDIO OS = internal machinery; STUDIO WORLD = digital office / spatial world / resident system
WAITING ROOM (directory) and EXIT 00 (return to origin) are named navigation concepts

Client app primary nav: HOME · PROJECT · REVIEWS · INBOX · LIBRARY; header: project name · diamond/project marker · notifications · menu; white/off-white shell; SITE 00 red default; bottom nav; must feel like a project room
Production workspace bottom nav: HUB · INBOX · DESIGN · EXPERIENCE · EXPRESSION · LIBRARY · ACTIVITY
Host vs project firewall: SITE 00 host chrome keeps SITE 00 language; project personality only inside; JURNL/AIO/FRONTAL SLAYER never rewrite host chrome; project data/assets/canon never bleed

Client permissions MAY: view, comment, review, approve, download, upload reference, send message, request revision; MAY NOT: generate, mutate canon, propagate, capture internal, apply source change, access provider/admin/internal production/model config/internal costs
CTRL ROOM = client account command center; 00 / CONTROL = internal operator environment (CORE.md)
Martian Mono is HOST typography and can never become CLIENT brand typography
